title: Lucia Caminos: the fighter at the heart of GTA 6

description:
Do you think Lucia's plan will work? 👇

Everything Rockstar has officially revealed about Lucia Caminos, GTA 6's co-protagonist: her family, Leonida Penitentiary and the life she wants. Based on Rockstar's official character bio.

scenes.text: Lucia Caminos was trained to fight as soon as she could walk.
Her father taught her, and her mother dreamed of the good life back in Liberty City.
Fighting for her family is what put her behind bars in Leonida Penitentiary.
And according to Rockstar, she only got out through sheer luck.
Now she wants the good life her mom always dreamed of, and she's committed to her plan, no matter what it takes, because
